Aims to stop OS-specific notes from rotting (missing pycapnp, wrong python3-zmq scope, pyzmq install claim) by centralizing them.

result.summary: This PR rewrites the test-suite dependency documentation, replacing OS-specific package install snippets in each build-*.md file with pointers to a single consolidated table in test/README.md. It also fixes several stated inaccuracies (missing pycapnp notes, python3-zmq being distro-specific rather than Unix-wide, pyzmq being installable via pip generally not just on macOS) and makes minor formatting/UTF-8-mode wording improvements. The change went through several rounds of review and multiple rebases/reworks over several months.
result.problem: Contributors following the build docs to set up the functional/IPC test suite hit inaccurate or missing per-OS instructions (e.g. no pycapnp guidance, wrong assumptions about package names), and the duplicated OS-specific notes were prone to drifting out of date, as seen in two recent doc-fix PRs (#33201, #34256).

open_concerns: fanquake: consolidating into a generic table removes immediately-usable, copy-pasteable OS-specific commands, forcing developers to go look up package names themselves; disputes that this is actually an improvement, and separately notes that pointing build-unix.md readers to test docs could produce spurious warnings about a missing Python dependency in the average build-only case.
maflcko and others raised various inline nits (netbsd lsof workaround, FreeBSD sqlite3 mention, wording for optional-dependency install methods) that were iteratively addressed across rebases.
resolved_concerns: maflcko's nits about wording, the UTF-8 mode section applicability, and specific package mentions were addressed by hebasto in subsequent pushes, with maflcko re-ACKing after each.
hebasto conceded fanquake's point about build-unix.md potentially causing spurious Python warnings ('Fair point') though no code change is shown resolving it definitively.

result.card: This PR consolidates scattered, drifting per-OS test-suite dependency instructions (across build-freebsd.md, build-netbsd.md, build-openbsd.md, build-osx.md, build-unix.md, build-windows-msvc.md) into a single table in test/README.md, fixing stated inaccuracies like missing pycapnp guidance and overstated OS-scoping of python3-zmq/pyzmq. The problem is real but modest: prior doc rot required follow-up fixes in #33201 and #34256, and outdated per-platform test setup instructions waste contributor time. fanquake disputes the core approach itself, arguing the consolidation removes immediately usable copy-paste package names in favor of a lookup table, and this objection remains unresolved through multiple rebases even as maflcko re-ACKed successive revisions and l0rinc gave a concept ACK. The PR is actively maintained, most recently reworked 2026-09-02, and is reviewable now with no mechanical blocker, though it conflicts with the unrelated open PR #35762. No hard dependency blocks it; it is a documentation-only change with no code or test-machinery impact.
